scopes.name: Technical SEO Audit & Independent Review
scopes.headline: Technical SEO Audit & Independent Review Services
scopes.summary: Find out why important pages struggle in search with a technical SEO audit and clear priorities.
scopes.body: A technical SEO audit should explain why a page is missing from search—not just return a list of red warnings. We investigate crawling, indexing, canonicals, redirects and internal links on the pages that matter to your business. Findings include evidence, affected URLs and practical priorities for your developer. If another provider has already given you a report, we can review whether its recommendations are supported. Implementation and follow-up checks are agreed separately.
scopes.fit: Websites with missing search results, broken links or technical problems that need investigation.
deliverables: Check of whether search engines can read important pages
Review of page addresses, redirects and sitemap
Checks of page links and website templates
A clear fix list for you and your developer
Priorities, responsibilities and a clear next-step recommendation
Review of your current plan and reports
Check of important service pages
Explanation of gaps and unclear claims
Independent recommendations and questions for your provider
scopes.inputs: Your website, available Search Console access, recent changes and existing SEO reports or recommendations you want reviewed.
scopes.measure: We review whether intended pages can be found and included in search results, using the available reports.

faq.q: Will you implement the technical SEO fixes?
faq.a: Implementation can be included as a separate agreed task or handled by your developers. The audit provides specific recommendations and checks for validating completed fixes.

faq.q: How do I get a quote for Technical SEO Audit & Independent Review?
faq.a: Share your website, target customers and the problem you want to solve. We review the requirements and explain deliverables, dependencies, timing and fees before work starts.

faq.q: Do I need to change my SEO agency?
faq.a: No. The review can help you ask better questions and agree clearer priorities with your current provider. Any implementation or ongoing support is a separate decision.

scopes.metaDescription: Audit crawling, indexing, redirects and canonicals, or get an independent review of your SEO plan. Receive evidence and clear implementation priorities.

scopes.name: On-page SEO & Content Strategy
scopes.headline: On-page SEO & Content Strategy Services
scopes.summary: On-page SEO and content strategy built around useful service pages and genuine customer questions.
scopes.body: When someone searches for your service, do they land on a page that answers what they need to know? We connect commercial keywords and customer questions to the right service pages, then improve headings, page copy, internal links and helpful next steps. Content briefs cover the questions that deserve a separate article instead of creating a new page for every keyword variation. You can choose a content plan, agreed page improvements or both.
scopes.fit: Businesses whose service pages are unclear or attract people looking for something else.
deliverables: Research of customer questions and search phrases
Improved page titles, headings and descriptions
Clearer service content on the agreed pages
Useful links between related pages
Priorities, responsibilities and a clear next-step recommendation
Research of customer problems and buying questions
Plan for useful service pages and articles
Writing instructions for the agreed content
Links and contact options to include
scopes.inputs: Your services, customer locations, accurate business information, existing content and website access for the agreed work.
scopes.measure: We review relevant search visits and enquiries from the agreed pages where tracking is available.

faq.q: Do you optimise for leads or keyword rankings?
faq.a: We connect relevant keywords to pages that can help customers buy. Rankings and traffic are supporting indicators; enquiry quality is reviewed when your tracking and sales information allow it.

faq.q: How do I get a quote for On-page SEO & Content Strategy?
faq.a: Share your website, target customers and the problem you want to solve. We review the requirements and explain deliverables, dependencies, timing and fees before work starts.

faq.q: Will every keyword need a new page?
faq.a: No. Similar searches can often be answered on one strong page. We recommend separate pages when the offer, audience or buying decision is meaningfully different.

scopes.metaDescription: Improve service pages, titles, headings and internal links. Plan SEO content briefs around customer questions, commercial intent and useful next steps.

scopes.name: Local SEO & Google Business Profile Services
scopes.headline: Local SEO & Google Business Profile Services
scopes.summary: Local SEO services for real service areas, clear Google Business Profiles and nearby enquiries.
scopes.body: Local search depends on accurate information about where you really work. We compare your website, eligible Google Business Profile and public listings, then review services, categories, location signals and contact routes. The goal is to help nearby customers understand whether you can help them. We do not create misleading service areas or promise a position in Maps.
scopes.fit: Businesses serving genuine towns, cities or local service areas.
deliverables: Review of local searches and nearby competitors
Improvements to agreed location and service pages
Check of consistent business details online
Recommendations for tracking calls and enquiries
Priorities, responsibilities and a clear next-step recommendation
Check of business listing information and eligibility
Recommendations for categories and services
Plan for useful photos, updates and review replies
Check of website, contact and booking links
scopes.inputs: Your real business locations, service areas, approved contact details and profile access.
scopes.measure: We review local enquiries, calls and bookings alongside available search visibility reports.

faq.q: Can you help my business appear on Google Maps?
faq.a: We can improve eligible profiles, consistency and supporting website content. Google determines Maps visibility; proximity, relevance and other factors mean positions cannot be guaranteed.

faq.q: Is Google Business Profile different from Local SEO?
faq.a: Your profile is one part of Local SEO. Website service pages, accurate business information and genuine local relevance also help customers understand and choose your business.

faq.q: Can I choose Business Profile work only?
faq.a: Yes. Business Profile optimization is available as a focused scope within our Local SEO service. We agree the profile tasks, access, deliverables and fees before work starts.

scopes.metaDescription: Local SEO and Google Business Profile support for genuine service areas, useful local pages and clear contact options.

scopes.name: SEO Website Migration Services
scopes.headline: SEO Website Migration Services
scopes.summary: SEO migration support for redesigned websites, URL changes and safer search transitions.
scopes.body: A website redesign should not leave your useful pages behind. Before launch, we review the existing URLs and identify where each important page will live on the new site. Redirects, navigation, canonicals and indexing settings are checked against that map. After the change, we look for broken journeys and unexpected search visibility losses, then prioritise corrections with your team.
scopes.fit: Businesses changing their domain, website platform, design or page structure.
deliverables: List matching important old pages to new pages
Plan to send old links to the correct new pages
Checks before launch
Checks after launch and a list of issues
Priorities, responsibilities and a clear next-step recommendation
scopes.inputs: Old and new website information, access where needed, your launch date and planned changes.
scopes.measure: We check that important old links reach the right pages and monitor available search reports after launch.

faq.q: When should SEO migration planning start?
faq.a: Before URLs, templates and launch plans are finalised. Early planning makes it easier to preserve useful content and avoid discovering missing redirects after the new website goes live.

faq.q: How do I get a quote for SEO Website Migration?
faq.a: Share your website, target customers and the problem you want to solve. We review the requirements and explain deliverables, dependencies, timing and fees before work starts.

scopes.metaDescription: Plan URL mappings, redirects and launch checks when your domain, CMS or website structure changes.

scopes.name: Organic Traffic Recovery Services
scopes.headline: Organic Traffic Recovery Services
scopes.summary: Organic traffic recovery that investigates lost rankings, indexing and website changes before suggesting fixes.
scopes.body: A traffic drop can come from a migration, indexing mistake, content change or something outside your website. We start by looking at when the decline began, which pages lost visibility and whether enquiries fell too. Search Console, analytics and site changes help narrow down likely causes. The recovery plan focuses on what the evidence supports—not generic fixes or promises of an instant rebound.
scopes.fit: Businesses that have seen a clear drop in visitors or enquiries from search results.
deliverables: Review of search and website visitor reports
Investigation of website and content changes
Identification of affected pages and searches
Recommended next steps in order of importance
Priorities, responsibilities and a clear next-step recommendation
scopes.inputs: Historical reports, dates of website changes and details of previous SEO work.
scopes.measure: We review affected pages and useful search enquiries over an agreed period.

faq.q: Can you guarantee that lost rankings will return?
faq.a: No. Recovery depends on the cause and wider search conditions. We explain the evidence, prioritise controllable issues and monitor relevant pages after agreed fixes.

faq.q: How do I get a quote for Organic Traffic Recovery?
faq.a: Share your website, target customers and the problem you want to solve. We review the requirements and explain deliverables, dependencies, timing and fees before work starts.

scopes.metaDescription: Investigate search traffic drops using available Search Console data, analytics and website change history.

scopes.name: AI SEO, AEO & GEO Services
scopes.headline: AI SEO, AEO & GEO Services
scopes.summary: AI SEO, AEO and GEO services focused on accessible answers and consistent business information.
scopes.body: People now look for business answers through both search engines and AI-powered experiences. We review whether your services, expertise, locations and common customer questions are explained clearly in accessible pages. Structured data and consistent business information can support that clarity, but no agency can guarantee an AI platform will cite or recommend a website. The practical goal is useful information that can stand on its own.
scopes.fit: Businesses wanting a clearer explanation of how their website supports Google and AI search.
deliverables: Review of business and service information
Check of accessible content and clear answers
Recommendations for supporting evidence
An agreed way to observe available search and AI results
Priorities, responsibilities and a clear next-step recommendation
scopes.inputs: Your website, accurate business information, approved supporting material and common customer questions.
scopes.measure: We review available mentions, visits and enquiries alongside normal search reports. AI results can vary between questions and users.

faq.q: Do AI SEO and GEO replace normal SEO?
faq.a: No. Useful content and sound technical SEO remain important. We plan overlapping improvements together and review available visibility evidence without treating AI mentions as guaranteed outcomes.

faq.q: How do I get a quote for AI SEO, AEO & GEO?
faq.a: Share your website, target customers and the problem you want to solve. We review the requirements and explain deliverables, dependencies, timing and fees before work starts.

scopes.metaDescription: AI SEO, AEO and GEO work focused on accessible pages, direct answers and consistent business information.
